summary: Pinterest requires a mandatory application review process before your app can access live data. Developers must verify their email, accept terms, and submit their app details for approval, which makes the setup process more involved than standard self-service platforms.

approval.notes: Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest and you will receive an email notification regarding approval or denial.

steps.title: Verify account and accept terms
steps.detail: Verify your account's email address and navigate to 'My apps' to accept the Developer Terms of Service.

steps.title: Register app details
steps.detail: Submit your application details for review to receive your app ID and secret key.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URI
steps.detail: On the Configure tab, scroll to the Redirect URIs section, enter your URI, and select Add to save.

nuances: Pinterest uses an access tier system; review the documentation on access tiers to understand what to expect at each level.
Trial access allows for testing, but full production access requires further review.
Product limited tokens are available for testing once Trial access is granted.
agent_can_do: Draft the application name and description for the submission form.
Identify the required scopes based on the API documentation.
Configure the redirect URI strings for the developer to input.
Store the Client ID and Secret in environment variables once provided by the developer.
human_must_do: Accept the Developer Terms of Service in the console.
Copy the Client ID and Secret from the dashboard after approval.
